title: WUSH-KV: KV Cache Quantization with Data-Adaptive Transforms
abstract: arXiv:2609.38121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV cache memory and bandwidth costs grow with context length and batch size, which limits efficient long-context inference. To address this bottleneck, we introduce WUSH-KV for low-bit KV-cache quantization. It adapts WUSH, which constructs a data-aware transform from the second-order statistics of both factors in a matrix product to reduce quantization error. WUSH-KV uses calibration data to construct separate key and value transforms, with the value transform folded into the model weights and the key transform applied after RoPE. The transforms can be paired with clipped quantizers. For one such quantizer, QuEST INT, we show that, under mild assumptions, the WUSH transform is near-optimal. With this quantizer, WUSH-KV reduces layerwise reconstruction error and achieves the lowest end-to-end perplexity among other tested transforms. For end-to-end evaluation, we integrate WUSH-KV into SGLang using OSCAR-style percentile-clipped affine q

translated_title: WUSH-KV：基于数据自适应变换的KV缓存量化
translated_abstract: KV缓存的内存和带宽成本会随着上下文长度和批处理大小的增长而增加，这限制了高效的长上下文推理。为了解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了WUSH-KV用于低比特KV缓存量化。它采用了WUSH方法，该方法从矩阵乘积中两个因子的二阶统计量构建数据感知变换，以降低量化误差。WUSH-KV使用校准数据构建独立的键变换和值变换，其中值变换被折叠进模型权重中，键变换则在RoPE之后应用。这些变换可以与截断量化器配合使用。对于其中的QuEST INT量化器，我们证明在温和的假设条件下，WUSH变换是近乎最优的。使用该量化器，WUSH-KV降低了逐层重构误差，并在所有测试的变换方法中实现了最低的端到端困惑度。在端到端评估方面，我们将WUSH-KV集成到SGLang中，采用OSCAR风格的百分位截断仿射量化……
tldr: 提出WUSH-KV方法，通过基于二阶统计量构建数据自适应变换对KV缓存进行低比特量化，将值变换折叠进模型权重、在RoPE后应用键变换，显著降低量化误差并取得最低的端到端困惑度。
en_tdlr: WUSH-KV enables low-bit KV cache quantization by constructing data-adaptive transforms from second-order statistics, folding the value transform into model weights and applying the key transform after RoPE, achieving the lowest end-to-end perplexity among tested transforms.
